checklist_items.title: Express Setup và Cơ Bản
checklist_items.description: Cài đặt, app.listen, app.get/post/put/delete, req/res objects, res.json/send/status, JSON body parsing, .env với dotenv
checklist_items.market_relevance: Express là Node.js framework phổ biến nhất — foundation of backend JS

checklist_items.title: Middleware System
checklist_items.description: app.use(), middleware function (req,res,next), application/router/error/built-in middleware, morgan logging, order of middleware
checklist_items.market_relevance: Middleware là core concept của Express

checklist_items.title: Router và Route Organization
checklist_items.description: express.Router(), route parameters (:id), query strings, route grouping, router.use() scoped middleware, mount với app.use()
checklist_items.market_relevance: Modular routing là key cho maintainable Express apps

checklist_items.title: Error Handling
checklist_items.description: Error middleware (4 params), custom error classes, async error handling, try/catch, next(err), express-async-errors
checklist_items.market_relevance: Proper error handling là thiết yếu cho production APIs

checklist_items.title: CORS và Security Headers
checklist_items.description: cors package, whitelist origins, credentials: true, helmet() security headers, Content-Type validation, HTTPS redirect
checklist_items.market_relevance: CORS và security headers bắt buộc cho bất kỳ API nào

checklist_items.title: Input Validation
checklist_items.description: Zod/Joi validation middleware, sanitization, schema-driven validation, error response format, type coercion
checklist_items.market_relevance: Never trust user input — validation là security fundamental

checklist_items.title: Authentication với JWT
checklist_items.description: JWT sign/verify, access + refresh tokens, HttpOnly cookies, auth middleware, role-based authorization, token revocation với Redis
checklist_items.market_relevance: JWT authentication là tiêu chuẩn cho REST APIs

checklist_items.title: Database Integration
checklist_items.description: Prisma/pg/mysql2, connection pooling, singleton pattern, transactions, migrations, graceful shutdown đóng pool
checklist_items.market_relevance: Database integration là core của backend development

checklist_items.title: Rate Limiting và DDoS Protection
checklist_items.description: express-rate-limit, windowMs/max config, Redis store cho distributed systems, per-route limits, auth endpoint protection
checklist_items.market_relevance: Rate limiting bắt buộc cho public APIs

checklist_items.title: RESTful API Design
checklist_items.description: HTTP methods, status codes, versioning (/api/v1), consistent response format, pagination, filtering, sorting, HATEOAS
checklist_items.market_relevance: REST API design skills là interview standard

checklist_items.title: File Upload với Multer
checklist_items.description: multer setup, diskStorage, memoryStorage, fileFilter, limits, S3 upload với multer-s3, virus scanning, magic bytes validation
checklist_items.market_relevance: File upload là common requirement trong web applications

checklist_items.title: Redis Caching
checklist_items.description: ioredis client, cache middleware, TTL, cache invalidation, cache-aside pattern, cache stampede prevention
checklist_items.market_relevance: Redis caching là key performance technique

checklist_items.title: Express với TypeScript
checklist_items.description: @types/express, RequestHandler generics, Request extension (req.user), typed error classes, strict tsconfig, ts-node-dev
checklist_items.market_relevance: TypeScript + Express là tiêu chuẩn trong production

checklist_items.title: WebSocket Integration
checklist_items.description: ws library, http.createServer + WebSocket.Server, connection/message/close events, broadcast, rooms, auth for WebSocket connections

checklist_items.title: API Documentation — Swagger/OpenAPI
checklist_items.description: swagger-jsdoc + swagger-ui-express, OpenAPI 3.0 schema, JSDoc annotations, tsoa framework, Postman integration

checklist_items.title: Performance và Scaling
checklist_items.description: PM2 cluster mode, Nginx reverse proxy, compression middleware, keep-alive, profiling với clinic.js/0x, gzip, HTTP/2
checklist_items.market_relevance: Performance optimization phân biệt senior và junior developer

checklist_items.title: Docker và Kubernetes Deployment
checklist_items.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile, non-root user, health checks, graceful shutdown, K8s Deployment/Service/HPA, secrets management
checklist_items.market_relevance: Containerization là industry standard cho deployment

checklist_items.title: Logging và Monitoring
checklist_items.description: Pino structured logging, correlation IDs, Sentry error tracking, Prometheus metrics, health check endpoint, OpenTelemetry
checklist_items.market_relevance: Observability là thiết yếu cho production systems
